LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.FeeModeHint: How caravans pay for their stall: on arrival, as a share of what guests spend (Hospitality or Hotels and Recreation), or not at all. Each market marker can set its own.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.FeePercentHint: The arrival fee is this share of the value of the goods the caravan carries.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.FeeCapHint: The arrival fee never goes above this, in silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.SharePercentHint: The market's cut of what guests spend at the stalls, left on the counter during the visit. What you buy yourself is never taxed.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.MarketDaysHint: How long a caravan stays at its stall before packing up.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.MaxMerchantsHint: How many caravans can trade at your market at the same time.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.HaggleBonusHint: What a good haggle takes off the prices, and what a bad one adds.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ThiefMtbHint: Average number of market days between two thieves.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.MessagesHint: Messages in the corner of the screen about what happens at the market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.FairCostHint: What the heralds charge to announce a Great Fair, in silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.FairCooldownHint: The least number of days between two Great Fairs.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.RouteOpenCostHint: Scales the price to open a route: about {0} silver for a town 20 tiles away.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.RouteTollHint: Scales the fee paid for each convoy: about {0} silver from 20 tiles away. 0% lets convoys come for free.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.FeeInGoods: Take goods if short of silver
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.FeeInGoodsHint: The merchant pays the difference with wares from the caravan, dropped at the stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.TurnAwayIfBroke: Turn away those who can't pay
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.TurnAwayIfBrokeHint: Off: they pay what they have and set up anyway. On: they skip the market and idle outside your walls like a vanilla caravan.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.WaiveAfterTollHint: Only matters when RimToll is loaded. A faction that paid your toll post less than a day ago is not charged a second time at the stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ShoppersVisitHint: An hour or two after a merchant sets up, a few people from a friendly faction walk over with some silver, browse the stalls, buy what they can afford and go home about five hours later, or the next morning if they took a bed at your inn. Groups also come for your colony stalls when no merchant is in town, as often as set below. No Hospitality needed.\n\nOff: no shoppers at all. Hospitality guests still buy.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ShoppersArrived: Shoppers from {0} have heard about the market and are walking over.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ShoppersForColonyStall: Shoppers from {0} have come to see what the colony has on its stalls.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ShoppersForBargains: Shoppers from {0} heard the colony sells cheap and have come for a bargain.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.InnPriceHint: Default price of a night in a room. A dorm costs half, a suite twice as much. Each colony can set its own prices in the inn register. The merchant pays for the caravan's guards, shoppers pay for themselves. Zero keeps the inn free.
LanguageData.RimMarket.CommandInnBedDesc: Rent this bed out to the people who come for the market: merchants, off-duty guards and passing shoppers. They pay by the night (price in the mod settings) and leave the silver by the bed. Colonists, prisoners and slaves will not use it. A nice private room pleases them, a bedroll in a shed does not.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnBedPrisonCell: A prison cell makes a poor inn.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnBedHotelGuest: This is a hotel guest bed. Take it off the hotel first.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnBedLocked: This bed is rented out as a market inn. Turn off Market inn first.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnTierDormDesc: A shared room, a shabby one, or a bed out in the open.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnTierRoomDesc: A private room that isn't shabby.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnTierSuiteDesc: An impressive private room with a double bed and some furniture by it, like an end table or a dresser.
LanguageData.RimMarket.BuildMenuDesc: Place market buildings without digging through the Architect menu: stalls, the caravan camp, the guard rest spot and the auction post.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnStayLonger: {0} slept like a king at your inn and keeps the stall open half a day longer.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnRegisterDesc: See your inn at a glance: who sleeps where tonight, what each bed has earned, the prices of each kind of room and what your guests wrote in the guest book.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnRegisterSummary: Tonight: {0} of {1} beds taken. So far the inn has made {2} silver over {3} nights.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnRegisterDefault: Default from the settings: {0} silver. Shift: 25 at a time.
LanguageData.RimMarket.InnRegisterJump: Click to go to this bed.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReportGoingToInn: heading for a bed at the inn.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.GuardsAtStallHint: They stand beside the counter and chase thieves. The other guards wait at your guard rest spot, the pack animals at your caravan camp. Without them, both wait just outside the market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.MaxGuardsHint: Caravans heading for a map with a market bring no more guards than this, the strongest ones. The rest stay home. Always at least one more than the guards per stall, so someone can take over.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.HaggleHint: One attempt per visit. Social skill and goodwill against the merchant's patience. Failure costs you the same amount the other way, and the merchant leaves earlier.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ColonistsBrowseHint: Idle colonists wander over, look at the wares and chat with the merchant. They never spend colony silver on their own.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.GuestsShopHint: Needs Hospitality or Hotels and Recreation. Guests with silver in their pockets, or budget left for their stay at your hotel, buy wares at the stalls and at your colony stall, and come to watch slave auctions. With the share of takings fee, the market takes its cut of every sale.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ExtraCaravansHint: A well liked market draws caravans on top of the ones the storyteller sends, up to one every two days or so. Turn it down for fewer visits, at 0% none come extra. Rarer merchants and better prices still work.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ReputationHint: A good reputation brings extra caravans, rarer merchants and better prices. A bad one makes caravans camp outside and prices climb. With this off, the reputation is still kept but changes nothing.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ThievesHint: Now and then a pickpocket mingles with the crowd, lifts something from a counter and runs for it. The caravan's guards give chase, and your colonists can tackle a fleeing thief with a right click. The more people around a stall, the less a thief dares.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ShowMarkerDesc: Show or hide the spot on the ground. The market keeps working either way, and the maypole still goes up on it during a Great Fair.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ShowSpotDesc: Show or hide the spot on the ground. It keeps working either way, and you can still select it by clicking its cell.
LanguageData.RimMarket.OpenMarketDesc: While open, trade caravans that arrive take a free stall inside this marker's area. Close it and new caravans idle outside your walls as usual; merchants already at a stall stay until they leave.
LanguageData.RimMarket.FeeModeDesc: How merchants pay for a stall in this market. Fee on arrival: silver counted on the counter before they set up. No fee: the stall is free. Or follow the mod setting.
LanguageData.RimMarket.FeeModeDescShare: Share of takings: a cut of what your guests (Hospitality or Hotels and Recreation) spend at the stall, left on the counter during the visit. What you buy yourself is never taxed.
LanguageData.RimMarket.CloseMarketDesc: Send every merchant at this market's stalls home right away. They pack up and leave by the usual road. Other markets on the map are not touched, and this does not close the market for future caravans.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaPaintDescMarket: Drag to add cells to the market square, like a stockpile zone. Once you paint, your shape replaces the circle.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaEraseDescMarket: Drag to take cells out of the market square. The marker always stays inside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaKeepMarket: The marker has to stay inside the market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaPaintDescCamp: Drag to add cells where the pack animals wait, like a stockpile zone. Once you paint, your shape replaces the circle.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaEraseDescCamp: Drag to take cells out of the camp. The spot always stays inside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaKeepCamp: The camp spot has to stay inside its area.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaPaintDescGuard: Drag to add cells where off duty guards sit, chat and eat, like a stockpile zone. Once you paint, your shape replaces the circle.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaEraseDescGuard: Drag to take cells out of the guards' area. The spot always stays inside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaKeepGuard: The rest spot has to stay inside its area.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AreaTooFar: Too far, this area reaches {0} cells at most from its spot.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MarkerGuestSales: Guests have spent {0} silver at the stalls
LanguageData.RimMarket.MarkerColonySales: The colony stalls have taken {0} silver
LanguageData.RimMarket.MarkerSecurity: Thieves caught {0}, got away {1}, scared off {2}.
LanguageData.RimMarket.TradingControlNote: A Trading Control spot is on this map: caravans wait there until a stall is free.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallNoMarker: No market marker covers this stall
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallUnreachable: Merchants cannot reach the merchant's spot from the map edge
LanguageData.RimMarket.SwapSideDesc: Move the merchant's spot to the other end of the stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.SwapSideBusy: A merchant is using this stall
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallFeeUnpaid: Stall fee: they had nothing to pay with
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallToggleDesc: Keep this stall for the colony's own goods. Visiting merchants will look elsewhere. Choose what it sells, how many and at what price in its sales table; your haulers bring the goods over, shoppers and guests pay at the counter, and the silver lands at the end of it for someone to put away.\n\nSwitching it back clears the table and puts whatever is left on the counter down in front of it.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallSetupDesc: Open the sales table: what this stall sells, how many and at what price.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallEmpty: Colony stall: nothing for sale yet. Use Set up the stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallRefillLine: {0}: kept at {1}, {2} on the counter, {3} of value
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallOrderLine: {0}: {1} to sell, {2} on the counter, {3} of value
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupIntro: Choose what goes on the counter, how many and at what price. Your haulers bring the goods over by themselves. A line stops once its count is sold, unless you tick Refill: then the stall keeps that many on the counter for good. Customers pay with their own silver; the dearer the article, the more of them walk on.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupQualityTip: Only goods in this quality range go on the counter. Pick a range to get rid of your poor stuff, or to sell only the good things.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupNoneAround: None on the map right now.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupRefillTip: Ticked: the stall keeps this many on the counter and your haulers bring more after every sale. The line never runs out.\nUnticked: it sells this many, then the line is done.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupReserveTip: Your haulers stop bringing this to the stall once the colony is down to this many, so you never sell your last medicine. What is already on the counter stays for sale.\n\nHold Shift for 10 at a time, Ctrl for 100.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupAdjustTip: How many to sell, out of what the colony has. With Refill ticked, how many to keep on the counter. Type a number in the box, or use the buttons: hold Shift for 10 at a time, Ctrl for 100. All: everything, or nothing if it is already everything.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupPriceHeaderTip: The asking price, as a share of the article's sell value. Like in vanilla, weapons sell for 20% of their worth and furniture for 70%. Shift: 25% at a time.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupPriceTip: {0} of its sell value: {1} silver each. At this price a customer who fancies it buys it {2} of the time.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupSummary: {0} articles to sell across {1} lines, about {2} silver if it all goes.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupDrawOff: Shoppers are switched off in the mod settings. Only Hospitality guests buy here.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupDraw: At these prices a group of shoppers comes about once every {0}, while the market is open in the daytime.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupDrawBargain: Word of the bargains gets around: a group of shoppers comes about once every {0}, while the market is open in the daytime.
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallSetupDrawDear: At these prices word gets around slowly: a group of shoppers comes about once every {0}, while the market is open in the daytime.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallNoKeeper: No shopkeeper at the counter, so nothing sells
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallTakings: Sold so far: {0} silver over {1} sales
LanguageData.RimMarket.ColonyStallNothingToSell: The stall has nothing to sell
LanguageData.RimMarket.StallRelief: Change of guard: {0} is coming to take over from {1}
LanguageData.RimMarket.TradeGizmoDesc: Send a colonist to the counter to trade with {0}.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RoundsDesc: Send one colonist to trade with every merchant at this market, one stall after the other, nearest first. The trade window opens at each counter.
LanguageData.RimMarket.TraderBusy: the merchant is not trading right now
LanguageData.RimMarket.TradeWhyAsleep: asleep, come back when they wake up
LanguageData.RimMarket.TradeWhyBusy: busy with something else, try again in a moment
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageNoNegotiator: Nobody can trade at this stall right now.
LanguageData.RimMarket.PlaceMerchantCellBlocked: The merchant's spot (outlined in white) must be free.
LanguageData.RimMarket.PaintAwningDesc: Pick an edge, a pattern and two colours for this stall's awning. Merchants have opinions about stripes. They keep them to themselves, mostly.
LanguageData.RimMarket.PlaceCanopyOverlap: Too close to another stall: the awnings would overlap.
LanguageData.RimMarket.PlaceCustomerCellBlocked: The customer's spot (outlined in cyan) must be free.
LanguageData.RimMarket.PlaceTakesNeighbourSpot: Would take the merchant or customer spot of the stall next door. Neighbours have long memories.
LanguageData.RimMarket.PlaceSpotUnderStall: The merchant or customer spot would end up inside another stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.HaggleTip: {0} tries to talk the prices down. One attempt per visit. Success: {1}% better prices both ways. Failure: {1}% worse, and the merchant packs up earlier.
LanguageData.RimMarket.CaravanWaitsDanger: The {0} caravan is shut in behind your walls. They saw the danger out there and will wait for it to pass rather than break out.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ChantOpen4: Lot {0}! {1}, best {2} you'll see all year!
LanguageData.RimMarket.ChantOpenPlain: Lot {0}! {1}, strong back, all their teeth!
LanguageData.RimMarket.ChantMore3: And {1} {2} on top, what a deal!
LanguageData.RimMarket.ChantWeak2: Don't ask {0} to do {1}, trust me.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ChantWeak3: {1}? Not so much. Everything else though!
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageSnatched: Thief! {0} grabbed {1} from the {2} stall and is running for it. Right-click the thief with a colonist to tackle them.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageThiefDeterred: {0} eyed the stalls, counted the people watching and decided to be honest today.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageThiefCaughtBy: {0} tackled the thief {1}. The goods go back to the merchant. Caught red-handed, the thief can go to prison without upsetting their faction, or you can leave them to limp home when they come to.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageThiefArrested: {0} arrested the thief {1}. The goods go back to the merchant.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageThiefCaught: The thief {0} is down. The goods go back to the merchant. Caught red-handed, the thief can go to prison without upsetting their faction, or you can leave them to limp home when they come to.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageCulpritCaptured: {0} was caught red-handed. {1} will not hold the arrest against you, and will not thank you for letting them go either.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageThiefEscaped: The thief got away with {0}. The {1} merchant blames your market and will pack up early.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageTakingStall: The {0} caravan is heading for the market. {1} takes a stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageMarketFull: The market is full: the {0} caravan waits outside until a merchant leaves.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageNoFreeStall: Every stall is taken: the {0} caravan waits outside until one frees up.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageNoReachableStall: The {0} caravan cannot reach any free stall. Select a stall to see what is blocking it.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageCannotAfford: The {0} caravan cannot afford the {1} silver stall fee and stays outside the market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageFeePaid: {0} paid the stall fee: {1} silver on the counter.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageFeeUnpaid: The {0} merchant had nothing to pay the stall fee with. The stall is theirs anyway.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageSharePaid: {0} left the market's share on the counter: {1} silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessagePackingUp: The {0} merchant packs up and leaves the market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageMarketClosedLeaving: The market is closing: the {0} merchant packs up.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageStallGone: The stall is gone: the {0} merchant packs up and leaves.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageLeavingEarly: The {0} merchant leaves the market early.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageFeudLeaving: The {0} merchant will not trade next to {1}, who are now their enemies, and packs up before anyone draws steel.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageMovingStall: The {0} merchant moves to another stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageHaggleWon: {0} talked the merchant down: {1}% better prices.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageHaggleLost: {0} pushed too hard. {1} is offended: worse prices, and the stall closes earlier.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReputationDesc: See what merchants say about your market, and what it changes.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepNotEstablished: Too few market days so far for anyone to have an opinion. Hold a few markets.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectCaravans: Word travels: an extra caravan comes for the market about every {0} days.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectRare: Rare merchants are more likely to make the trip.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectRefusal: About {0}% of caravans refuse to set up at your market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectPricesBetter: Merchants give {0}% better prices at your stalls.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectPricesWorse: Merchants charge {0}% more at your stalls.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectNone: Nothing yet. Your market is neither famous nor infamous.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectsOff: Reputation effects are turned off in the mod settings.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepFactionNote: The bars show what they remember of their own visits. Their opinion mixes that memory ({0}%) with what everyone says about your market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepFactionUnknown: Too few visits from {0} so far for them to trust their own memory.
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectsHeaderFaction: What it changes for their caravans:
LanguageData.RimMarket.RepEffectRefusalFaction: Their caravans refuse to set up about {0}% of the time.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageVerdictPleased: The {0} merchant packs up with a smile: {1}.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageVerdictGrumbling: The {0} merchant packs up grumbling about {1}.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageRefuseUnsafe: The {0} caravan has heard your market is a den of thieves and camps outside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageRefuseUnfair: The {0} caravan has heard merchants get a raw deal at your market and camps outside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageRefuseRacket: The {0} caravan will not pay your racket and camps outside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageRefuseShabby: The {0} caravan has heard your market is not worth the detour and camps outside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageRefuseGrudge: The {0} caravan remembers its last market day here and camps outside.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.AwayStallsHint: Lets a caravan set up a stall at a friendly settlement for one market day and sell its goods to the townsfolk. Allies charge a smaller stall fee. Food and medicine stay with the caravan.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.HegemonyPricesHint: Stalls in other towns sell at that town's Hegemony prices: goods it lacks sell for more, goods it has plenty of for less.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.HegemonyStock: Sold goods fill the town's stock
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.HegemonyStockHint: Materials and other goods Hegemony accepts go into the town's reserves when your away stall sells them. Off: they simply vanish, like without Hegemony.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.HegemonyGoodwillHint: Colony stall sales, away stall sales and auctions count toward Hegemony's trade goodwill, like trading in the vanilla trade window.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.HegemonyTerritoryHint: Trade convoys crossing land claimed by a hostile faction risk an ambush from that faction.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayOption: Hold a market stall at {0} (one day)
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayReport: going to hold a stall at {0}
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayStallTaken: another of your caravans holds a stall here
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayCooldown: their market saw your stall recently, come back in {0}
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayStarted: {0} sets up a stall at the {1} market for one market day. The stall fee is {2}% of sales.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayTownHolding: Your caravan {0} holds a stall at the market here.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayTownCooldown: Your stall was here recently. Their market will have you back in {0}.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayCaravanInspect: Holding a stall at {0}: {1} left, {2} items sold for {3} silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayInspectFestival: Festival day: twice the usual crowd.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayInspectRival: A rival merchant is taking half the customers.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayGoodsDesc: Pick what goes on the counter and what stays in your bags.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayGoodsIntro: Untick what stays in your bags, the rest goes on the counter. Food and medicine never do. You can change it any time with the Stall goods button on the caravan.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayGoodsSummary: {0} of {1} kinds of goods on the counter, worth about {2} silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayPackUpDesc: Close the stall now and get ready to leave. Moving the caravan does the same.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEventRival: A rival merchant has set up across the square at {0}. Half your customers wander over to them.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEventFestival: It is a festival day at {0}. Twice the usual crowd, and everyone has spending money.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEventRich: A wealthy customer bought the {0} for {1} silver without haggling, which is rude in its own way.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEventPickpocketCaught: {0} caught a pickpocket by the wrist before anything left the stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEventPickpocket: A pickpocket walked off with {0} {1}. Nobody saw a thing, as is traditional.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayLost: Your stall at {0} is gone: the caravan or the market is no longer there.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEndNormal: {0} packs up its stall at {1} at the end of the market day.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEndPackedUp: {0} packs up its stall at {1} early.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEndMoved: {0} left {1} and took its stall along.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayEndSoldOut: {0} sold everything it put up at the {1} market and packs up.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AwayTakings: Takings: {0} items sold for {1} silver, {2} of it paid to the market.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.SlaveAuctionsHint: When a caravan with slaves for sale sets up at your market and an auction post stands in the square, the slaver auctions them there, one lot at a time. Buyers from other factions come to bid, your guests join in, and so can you.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionBuyersComing: Buyers are on their way for the auction: {0}. They take a seat in front of the post, bid with their own silver and leave with whatever they win.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionNextLot: Auction under way: next lot in {0}.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionBidLine: Current bid: {0} silver by {1}. The gavel falls in {2}.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionColonySilver: Your colony has {0} silver to bid with.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionBidDesc: Bid {1} silver for {0}. If nobody outbids you before the gavel falls, the silver comes out of your stockpiles and {0} is yours, as if bought from the slaver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionYouLead: your colony holds the highest bid
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionNotEnoughSilver: not enough silver in your stockpiles for a bid of {0}
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionAnnounced: The {0} slaver will auction off the slaves they brought ({1} lots) at your auction post in two hours. Bring silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionLotOpen: Lot {0} at the post: {1}. Bidding opens at {2} silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionCannotPay: Your colony could not pay for {0} when the gavel fell. The slaver keeps them.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionSoldToYou: Sold to your colony: {0}, for {1} silver.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionNoTakers: No takers for {0}. The slaver keeps them.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionBuyerGone: The winning bid on {0} fell through: the buyer is gone or can't pay. The slaver keeps the lot.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionNoSlaves: The {0} slaver has no one to sell this time, so there is no auction.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionNoSlavesIdeo: The {0} slaver has no one to sell: their ideology does not approve of slavery, whatever the sign on the wagon says. No auction today.
LanguageData.RimMarket.AuctionNoBlock: The {0} slaver brought slaves to sell ({1}), but no auction post stands in this market square.
LanguageData.RimMarket.WaitUnreachable: the free stalls are out of their reach
LanguageData.RimMarket.WaitMarketFull: the market has reached its merchant limit (mod settings)
LanguageData.RimMarket.MessageWordSpread: Word of your market has spread: a caravan from {0} ({1}) is coming for the market day.
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReasonRacket: a fee that smells of racket
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReasonTaxedTwice: being taxed twice in one day
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReasonBigMarket: a proper market with plenty of stalls
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReasonInnFine: a good night at your inn
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReasonInnPoor: a flea-bitten night at your inn
LanguageData.RimMarket.ReasonInnSteep: paying through the nose for a bed
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ColonyShopperDays: Colony stall shoppers, one group every
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.ColonyShopperDaysHint: How often a group of shoppers walks over for the colony stalls when no merchant is in town, counting only daytime market hours, with prices at 110% of value. Cheaper or dearer stalls change this, as set below.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.BargainEffectHint: 100%: shoppers come twice as often to a stall selling at 85% of value or less, and about a third as often at double the value. 0%: prices change nothing about how often they come, only whether they buy. 200%: bargains are the talk of the region.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.DifficultyHint:
How hard your market has to work for its silver.

Relaxed: your stalls sell a bit dearer, demand drops slowly, shoppers carry more silver and thieves come less often.
Standard: the market as intended.
Tough: your stalls sell a bit cheaper, demand drops fast, shoppers carry less and thieves come more often, drawn harder by your takings.
LanguageData.RimMarket.MarkerWealthThieves: Word of your takings draws thieves: x{0}
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.MarketSaturation: Demand drops when you flood the market
LanguageData.RimMarket.Settings.MarketSaturationHint: Selling a lot of the same thing at your colony stalls lowers demand for it: it sells less often and for less, then demand comes back over a few days. Vary what you sell. With Vanilla Trading Expanded only the selling chance drops, VTE already lowers the price.

LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.GizmoDesc: Open the market guide: where to place everything, what your market still needs on this map, and why no caravan has come yet.
LanguageData.RimMarket.GuideLetterText: The marker is down. Now build a few market stalls inside its area, keep the merchant's spot at the end of each counter free, and leave caravans a way in from the map edge.\n\nSelect the marker and press Guide to see, step by step, what your market still needs and why no caravan has come yet.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.Title: Market guide
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.NoMap: Load a colony to see where your market stands.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.MarkerBody:
Everything starts with the market marker (Architect, Misc). Put it in the middle of your square: every stall inside its area belongs to the market. The area is a circle around it at first.

Select it to paint the area by hand like a stockpile or erase part of it, set the stall fee, open or close the market, see your reputation and announce a Great Fair. Once the square is built you can hide it.

The area reaches at most 30 cells from the marker. For a bigger market, or one inside and one outside your walls, place another marker: you can have several, on this map or on others.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.MarkerPlaced: A market marker on this map
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.StallsBody: Build market stalls (Architect, Misc) inside the marker's area. Each one needs its merchant's spot free: the cell at the end of the counter, outlined in white while you place it.\n\nCaravans walk in from the map edge and open your doors like any friendly visitor, so leave them a way in. The counter takes the colour of its material, and the awning is yours to paint from the stall.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.StallInside: At least one stall inside the marker's area
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.StallNoneOutside: No stall left outside the marker's area
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.StallSpotFree: The merchant's spot is free on every stall
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.StallFromEdge: Caravans can walk to every stall from the map edge
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.StallThree: Three stalls or more, for a Great Fair
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.SpotsBody: Two spots keep the square tidy (Architect, Misc). The caravan camp is where the pack animals wait: fence it in and they stay put. The guard rest spot is where off duty guards sit, chat and eat while one of them stands post at the stall. Select a spot to paint its area by hand, like a stockpile.\n\nBoth are optional and can go anywhere on the map, inside or outside the market: caravans use the nearest one. Without them, animals and guards wait just outside the market. Each spot can be hidden once you know where it is.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.SpotCamp: A caravan camp for the pack animals
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.SpotRest: A guard rest spot for the escort
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.FeesBody: Merchants pay a stall fee on arrival, counted out on the counter, then stay a market day. Trade with them from the stall or by talking to the merchant, with the usual trade window.\n\nOnce per visit you can haggle from the trade window: it uses your negotiator's Social skill, and a failure costs as much as a success would have gained. The fee, haggling and the length of a market day are in the mod settings, and a marker can set its own fee.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.ColonyStallBody: Any stall can sell your own goods: select it and make it a colony stall. Its sales table lists what you own. Pick what to sell, how many and at what price, and your haulers bring the goods over.\n\nShoppers from friendly factions and your guests pay at the counter. Cheaper prices bring shoppers by more often. Selling a lot of the same thing lowers demand for it for a few days, the bar under each name in the sales table shows it, so vary your goods.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.InnBody: Any bed can become an inn bed: select it and press the market inn button. It can be anywhere on the map, it doesn't need to be inside the market. Merchants, their guards and shoppers pay by the night, and a caravan pays out of its packs. Rooms come in three kinds: a dorm (shared or shabby) costs half, a room the full price, a suite (an impressive private room with a double bed and an end table or dresser) twice as much. Merchants and their guards get the beds first, and the merchant takes the best room. The inn register, on the marker or any inn bed, shows every bed, sets the prices and keeps a guest book of what your lodgers thought. A merchant who sleeps in a fine room at a fair price keeps the stall open half a day longer, and guards who slept at the inn are quicker to tackle a thief the next day.\n\nA fine private room makes your market more appealing, a poor room or a steep price does the opposite. Guests who slept well at a fair price also leave on slightly better terms with you.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.FairBody: With three stalls or more, the marker can announce a Great Fair three days ahead. On the day, up to six caravans set up at once, crowds of shoppers come with fuller purses, and your colonists come to enjoy it.\n\nAt six in the evening the judges pick the best stall. The fair closes at ten with sky lanterns, or fireworks if most stalls are built from metal.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.AuctionBody: Build an auction post (Architect, Misc) inside the market. When a caravan brings slaves, the auction is announced two hours ahead and buyers come to sit in front of the post. Each lot opens at half its value.\n\nSelect the post while a lot is up to bid. If nobody outbids you, the silver comes out of your stockpiles and the slave joins your colony.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.HegemonyBody:
With Hegemony, the towns you trade with keep real stocks.

When your caravan holds a stall in a town, it sells at that town's prices: goods the town lacks sell for more, goods it has plenty of for less. Materials you sell go into the town's reserves.

Sales at your colony stalls, at your stalls in other towns and at auctions count toward Hegemony's trade goodwill, like trading in the vanilla trade window.

Trade convoys crossing land held by a hostile faction can be ambushed by it.

Each part can be turned off in the Trade settings.
LanguageData.RimMarket.Guide.RoutesBody: From the comms console you can open a trade route (a town sends a convoy every week or two), place a special order for a cartload of goods, or post a wanted notice. Towns answer the notice over the next days, and you accept their offers from the marker.\n\nYour own caravans can also hold a stall in a friendly town for a market day.
